text: In 1587, a French town actually sued
tiny green weevils for eating their vineyards.
The church court even gave the bugs real defense lawyers,
lawyers argued bugs held prior rights to eat green leaves.
Panicked villagers offered the bugs free land,
yet the lawyer rejected it as rocky dirt.
Months of delays dragged on until the bishop finally penned a verdict.
History never learned who won, because insects literally chewed up the last page!
